chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, concerning:
A man who wants to attend to a need or to sleep when the sun declines, so he begins by praying the first prayer at that time. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْحَاجَةَ: a need or matter requiring attention
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray the first prayer at the sun’s decline before attending to a need or going to sleep?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding praying the first prayer at the time of the sun’s decline when a person intends to attend to a need or to sleep. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem in doing so, indicating permissibility in this circumstance.
